The '''Feena Run''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] between [[Feena]] and [[Korphir]] in the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]]. It ran behind the [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] known as [[The Roil/Legends|the Roil]]. Worlds along its path included [[Barison]], [[Usta]], and [[the Cometwash]].
